hook_line: FOREIGN INVESTORS PUMP ₹84,290 CRORE INTO INDIAN STOCKS

hook_stat.sub: Net FPI buying in Indian equities, November 2-13

stats.label: Withdrawn in September and October before the reversal
First-week drop in Brent crude to about $97 a barrel
Cumulative 2026 FPI outflow, down from nearly ₹3 lakh crore

diaspora_bullets: Financials, telecom and pharmaceuticals led the buying
Strategists call the turn tactical, not yet structural
news_summary: Foreign portfolio investors put a net ₹84,290 crore into Indian equities between November 2 and 13, reversing two straight months of outflows, depository data reported by PTI shows.
payoff: FPIs remain net sellers for 2026 overall, despite the inflow.
